patch.value: Align claim guidance with atomic ownership refusal

Current pm claim --help --explain says non-terminal takeover does not require --force, and Agent Guide repeats the older takeover policy. Current SDK runClaim correctly rejects a different claim principal without force or permits an explicit --if-available skip. Reconcile user and agent guidance with the shipped atomic semantics without weakening ownership.

Reproduce explained help and distinct-principal claim behavior; Search all public and generated claim ownership guidance; Preserve atomic test-and-set and non-destructive --if-available semantics; Validate documented examples without invoking an unauthorized real takeover
Help and agent documentation describe the current claim, skip and explicitly approved takeover contracts consistently.
